desk.name: desk
desk.textSnippet: The green join block sticks two things together, so this says the words Score: followed by whatever number is in the score box.
desk.contentAnchor: The green join block sticks two things together, so this says the words Score: followed by whatever number is in the score box.
desk.cardText: Your challenge: match all six blocks to their Python lines. · How it works: click a block, then a Python line. A wrong pair comes back. · SCRATCH BLOCKS · This block makes your character say Hello! in a speech bubble on the screen. · This block puts the number 0 into a variable called score. A variable is a box with a name on it that holds one value for you. · This block adds 1 to whatever is already in the score box. · This block puts the word Aoife into a variable called name. Words go in spee
desk.says: the top of the matching desk before anything is matched: the blocks on the left, the lines of Python on the right

build.name: build
build.textSnippet: How it works: click or drag a line into Your program. Drag it back to take it out. Python runs the top line first.
build.contentAnchor: How it works: click or drag a line into Your program. Drag it back to take it out. Python runs the top line first.
build.cardText: SCOREBOARD · STARS · LEVEL UP · Build the scoreboard. Four of these seven lines make it work. · The score starts at 0. It goes up by one, twice. Then the console prints the word Score: followed by the number. · THE TARGET — MAKE THE CONSOLE PRINT EXACTLY THIS · Score: 2 · How it works: click or drag a line into Your program. Drag it back to take it out. Python runs the top line first. · THE LINES · score = score + 1 · print("Score: " + score) · print("Score: " + str(score) · score = score + 1 ·
build.says: the build screen before a line is moved: the target, the lines, the empty program and RUN still asleep
